notes.title: Farmer's Life Summer Update
notes.content: [h3]Working on the farm has never been so fun. The sun is shining, not too cold, not too warm, before the Summer Holidays... and with an Update![/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35624648/aaf6caf7762c9c941c9c663077fc752d6d1ab8fd.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][u]What's changed[/u] in Farmer's Life Update 1.0.34[/h3][p][/p][p]- Thadeus has an idea for a new invention: the Mechanical Chainsaw. Before he starts selling it, however, you'll need to complete a few tasks for him.[/p][p]- Helen also has an idea for a new invention: the Cigarette Roller. Once mounted on a work stool, it greatly simplifies the process of producing tobacco products — but first, you'll need to finish a few jobs for Helen.[/p][p]- Hand-rolling cigarettes can now be done not only with the mouse, but also using the up/down keys or the forward/backward joystick axis.[/p][p]- Kasimir has finally overcome his fear of jumping. If he builds up enough speed and isn't overburdened, he can even jump over fences! (Some activities prevent jumping.)[/p][p]- Kasimir realized the attic in his old house has stood unused for years. It can now be accessed and used via an outside entry.[/p][p]- Kasimir has learned to organize space better, so all cabinets, dressers, and other furniture now have double the capacity.[/p][p]- Kasimir can now access item containers even while standing on a ladder.[/p][p]- Stefan discovered that the ladders he sells were too long and cumbersome for some people. From now on, he also offers medium and short versions.[/p][p]- Stan from the State Farm has — completely free of charge (!) — mounted small toolboxes on all of Kasimir’s tractors for the most essential tools.[/p][p]- Fences built by Kasimir now try their best to look better on uneven terrain. Still not perfect, but an improvement nonetheless.[/p][p]- Kasimir has learned to search wild dumps more thoroughly. In addition to scrap, he now finds bottles, jars, boards, and other small items.[/p][p]- When selling directly from wagons, items that the merchant isn't interested in are now greyed out, just like in regular hand-to-hand trade.[/p][p]- Plows and harrows "sample" the soil more frequently, leaving fewer missed patches.[/p][p]- Kasimir can now choose the color of livestock he wants to purchase.[/p][p]- Kasimir discovered that straw can be used to line animal pens using a pitchfork. This improves cleanliness, post-birth recovery, milk yield, and wool regrowth.[/p][p]- Kasimir also found that feeders can be placed in pens in such a way that they don’t get in the animals’ way (i.e., near the doors or the opposite side).[/p][p]- The issue with animals crowding into a single stall in the barn has been resolved. You’ll just need to rescue them one last time.[/p][p]- The same fix applies to animals “automatically” returning to stalls they shouldn't — unless your wife has told them to.[/p][p]- Automatic milkers will no longer attempt to milk bulls, male goats. Or calves.[/p][p]- Automatic milkers no longer appear in regular old animal pens (in brick buildings).[/p][p]- The spots where you removed old fences near the house can now be cultivated like any other soil.[/p][p]- The “Fresh Milk” quest (for Sophia) now accepts either a cow or a goat and also counts milk from automatic milkers.[/p][p]- Maria at the State Farm now buys strawberries.[/p][p]- Turns out some prankster painted our male geese to look like barnacle geese. After a bath, it’s clear they’re just normal saddleback males.[/p][p]- Wives no longer walk around barefoot after coming back from work.[/p][p]- Floating socks in the yard should no longer haunt Kasimir’s farm.[/p][p]- Cats and dogs can now enter Kasimir’s house. Cats sleep in the kitchen — whether Kasimir likes it or not.[/p][p]- Save file deletion is now much more convenient. You can even delete all files at once — so be careful![/p][p][/p][p]So let's get started:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1137750/Farmers_Life/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy your farming,[/p][p] [/p]

notes.title: Update 1.0.33
notes.content:
[h3]Today we have a sale (starting at 7 pm) and an update. If you still haven't got Farmer's Life , get it now ;)[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1137750/Farmers_Life/

[h3]Changes[/h3]
- Kasimir has learned how to build modern animal stalls. (Outdated stalls must be destroyed before placing new ones.) If the building housing the new stall has a completed electrical installation, cows and goats inside will milk themselves. The collected milk accumulates in a tank and must be gathered manually.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35624648/109e6cec9af8aa4e15f5f0fe4fe65a16e5d1048e.gif[/img]

- Bags, packages, crates, and other handheld containers can now be thrown towards chests and storage structures.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35624648/c07590f264a99aadd31f5c0cc532c73bae229016.gif[/img]

- The harvester, chaff cutter, and threshing machine have been given a bag-ejecting function. This makes it easy to transfer the output from these machines onto a cart, trailer, or into storage.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35624648/425cfedf9ebb5a5e822c94e15975e8e06244a7b3.gif[/img]

- Kasimir can now instantly assess the contents of any cart or trailer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35624648/eb2891521ec74e1b6bee1418c704557701f8e292.gif[/img]

- You no longer have to sell everything directly from the cart or trailer. You can precisely choose what and how much Kasimir will sell to each trader.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35624648/42d334f94d809471dcc033b2f71dfcf78aaef106.gif[/img]

- If Kasimir parks the seeder right next to a storage or seed chest, he can quickly transfer large amounts of seeds using the UI.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35624648/0da97db3804dfb1e4611ee5b54e1e9c136646c09.gif[/img]

- Larger quantities of milk no longer appear as a regular sack. We now have a nice, classic milk can.
- You can now get rid of the indestructible hollyhocks and sunflowers growing near the house.
- Dismantling and packing up a wardrobe or cupboard will no longer destroy everything stored inside.
- Using sourdough for bread now returns an empty jar.
- A new cow color variant has appeared in Zalesie: the classic black and white dairy cow.
- When purchasing items that don’t appear directly in your inventory, the camera now clearly shows where they’ve been placed.
- The journal now contains a list of all completed quests.
- We’ve improved the appearance of mature rapeseed, but the sowing season remains unchanged. We're not ready for winter crops just yet.
- When trimming branches from a felled tree, they now go directly into Kasimir's inventory.
- You can jump off a ladder even if there’s no nearby surface to safely land on.
- From time to time, we’ll bother you with questions. Please don’t ignore Fluffy asking for attention in the main menu. With your help, we’ll make Farmer’s Life an even better game!
- The newer tractor is now slightly more powerful, because it's a shame for it to pull a plow at the same speed as Kasimir's old tractor.
- Chickens lay eggs, and cows and goats fill their udders at the same time every day, regardless of the season. This way, wives always have time to take care of them before heading to work.

[h3]Just to let you know, our publisher has 3 important announcements lately:[/h3]

1. [b]Purrrifiers: Cleaning Chaos[/b] - a crazy co-op "cleaning simulator" has announced [u][b]Kickstarter[/b][/u]:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2117430/view/521964211468763226

2. [b]House Builder 2[/b] - a sequel of the first (and only?) simulator where you can  build all over the world and throughout the history now [u]gets a demo[/u]. Check it out:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2827960/view/512956388211687924

3. [b]Aquarist[/b] has a new [u]DLC launch and big sale[/u] today, so if you still haven't get it now will be the best time. Here is a bundle with Farmer's Life:
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/25160/Farmer_and_Aquarist/

Enjoy,
Farmer's Life team

notes.content:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3468940/Farmers_Life_Spread_the_Bread_DLC/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35624648/a0a6de12592759d7ba077c2f734a486c2f1e0ab1.png[/img][/url]

Today is the time we all have been waiting for "some" time now. We have a lot of goodies for you:

[list]
[*] Miller Paul will buy grain from you and turn it into flour, but he needs your help first.
[*] You can purchase a hand mill for yourself if you need a small amount of flour quickly.
[*] The miller's daughter, Alicja, will introduce you to the world of baking, both savory and sweet.
[*] Additionally, you can now prepare jams and dishes that incorporate them.
[*] New vegetables for cultivation (cucumbers and tomatoes) will allow you to prepare new meals.
[*] A new large-scale crop (rapeseed) will change the color of your fields (and help you earn even more).
[*] A new fruit bush (strawberries) will provide fresh strawberries every year.
[*] Ducks and geese will diversify your poultry farming.

[h3]2. [u][b]Two new bundles[/b][/u] for Farmer's Life fans:[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/51641/Farmers_Life_Ultimate_Bundle
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/51640/Baking_of_the_Farm

[h3]3. [u][b]Free Major Update[/b][/u] is out now in Farmer's Life[/h3]
[list]
[*] A new location southeast of Kazimierz's farm: the mill.
[*] You can now build signposts and boards with editable text. Both can also be painted.
[*] We've added a new graphics quality preset: Hyper. It mainly affects the distance at which objects, including vegetation, appear.
[*] The issue with constructing brick buildings from the inside has been resolved.
[*] Gates in animal stalls inside brick buildings now have the correct interaction order.
[*] They can also be opened inward and produce appropriate sounds.
[*] Animals tethered with a chain no longer flee in response to player actions (shooting, driving a tractor, etc.).
[*] Chickens will no longer sink under chicken coops while sleeping, but the ones that have already sunk need to be rescued first. Sorry for the inconvenience.
[*] A new type of tree (birches) adds charm to the surroundings and your farm (saplings available at the sawmill).
[*] The "Family Treasure" quest is now slightly easier to complete.
[*] You can now create properly designed liquor crates instead of the default sack.
[*] Honey mash no longer requires sugar.
[*] After digging up a tree sapling, you recover it if the tree hasn't fully grown.
[*] Items carried in hand no longer twitch chaotically.
[*] Vehicle wheels now behave in a less chaotic manner.
[*] You can no longer ride immature animals in a weird pose.
[*] Foals can no longer be harnessed for hard labor.
[*] Our Discord link in the main menu finally leads to the correct invitation.
[*] Women gifted dresses now return them if the player asks them to revert to their previous clothing.
[*] The price of fish fillets has been increased to make them actually worth producing.
[*] As always, many minor improvements and optimizations.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.26
notes.content:
[h3]Important[/h3]
After the 1.0.24 update, all players noticed "plowed" and untouchable areas next to the barn on Kasimir's farm. This is a side effect of our tests. It has ben reverted, but some of you may need to re-plow these areas using any method.

We remind you that if there is more than one animal in a stall at a time, take out the ones you can using "take animal out" and for the rest, use the lead option and take advantage of fast travel.
From now on, they shouldn't experience this shared overnight stay anymore.

Chickens are avoiding the use of teleportation, so if they’re stuck somewhere, you’ll need to help them. Or end their suffering if they’re out of your reach.

[h3]Zmiany[/h3]
- The cultivator no longer behaves as if it’s still working after being detached from the tractor.
- Falling off the bicycle no longer results in a Buddha-like effect or strange positions while continuing to ride.
- Building construction now removes not only grass but also larger vegetation.
- Chickens no longer treat doors to concrete buildings as if they don't exist.
- The shape of entry ramps to concrete buildings has been improved, so poultry should no longer have trouble getting inside.
- The two-wheeled cart has been "calmed down" a bit, but in collisions with other equipment, it can still explode. We're investigating the issue and will implement the necessary fixes.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.25
notes.content:
- Loading save files from before the update should no longer cause issues.
- Kazimierz's movement has returned to normal.
- Using fast travel on a bicycle no longer ends with a trip to the sky or beneath the terrain.

[b]Important[/b]
If you played and saved the game after receiving a message about an incorrectly loaded file, I suggest starting from a save file made before the update.
This will help you avoid unexpected losses that may have occurred due to the incorrect file loading.

Before releasing the update, we tested many of your save files, but as you can see, not thoroughly enough.
We sincerely apologize for the problems caused.

notes.title: Update 1.0.24
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=ty9eE0Fbl7E;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Changes[/h3]

[b]Clothes[/b]
- Kasimir has discovered that he can live without his beloved cap on his head. In fact, the rest of his clothes can also be swapped for something else.
- Clothing affects body temperature. During harsh winters, a bearskin outfit will allow long hours outdoors. But on hot days, it's better to wear something lighter. Or nothing at all.
- Johnny at the Zalesie market has started selling clothes. If you want to look like the Mayor, be sure to talk to our toolsmith.
- If winter is raging in your game right now, at least get yourself a sweater.
- Kasimir can now set up a new station: the sewing workshop. Only here can clothes be made from the skins of hunted animals. You can also create woolen string and dresses.
- As part of Johnny's tasks, you can obtain two types of military uniforms.
- Kasimir can gift selected clothing to the women of Zalesie, and they will put it on immediately.
- Kasimir's wife changes into something more comfortable for the night than her work clothes.
- When winter comes, the residents of Zalesie dress appropriately instead of freezing in light clothing.
- Kasimir now reacts to temperature changes faster, so it no longer takes several hours by the stove to warm up.

notes.title: Update 1.0.21
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=07NR_rSA2Lc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Changes[/h3]
- Kasimir can now arrange the interior of the old barn as he wishes. You can even remove all the stalls and set up a moonshine distillery inside.
- Kasimir has learned to build a new type of building using concrete blocks.
- Kasimir has learned to build simple dog houses for his dogs.
- Connections between machines (e.g., tractor with a trailer) are now more stable. Swaying has been eliminated.
- A cart hitched to a horse still sways. Exactly as in reality. We've checked.
- Pulling bags, boxes, crates, and barrels straight from the inventory near machines no longer causes them to fly off into space.
- You can now sell the s60 engine, table saw, and chopper to the residents who sell them.
- You can sell the old tractor, new tractor, motorcycle, and even the combine harvester to Stan at the State Agricultural Farm (SAF). Such a sale is irreversible!
- Using solvent on the floor no longer removes wallpaper and paint from the entire interior.
- You can no longer paint the floor. It may have looked nicer, but it led to unpleasant consequences.
- You can no longer accidentally mow tree seedlings with a scythe. You have to take a shovel and dig them up.
- You can now rotate bales of straw or hay while holding them in your hands. They also don’t fall from the attics when the player moves too far away.
- The building and station destruction mode now gives time to react to stop the process if it is used on the wrong object by mistake.
- You can now use fast travel while holding a ladder in your hands.
- Animals should now stop disappearing. They may still change their position in surprising ways. We are working to ensure they stay in their enclosures.
- Steven now offers a larger amount of asbestos sheets and concrete blocks.
- Metal stalls for animals in concrete buildings no longer change into wooden ones without reason.
- Interior furnishings introduced by DLC no longer duplicate.
- You can no longer use "Take all" when the item quantity slider is open.
- The issue with the game not recognizing the horse being led into the stall (in the introduction) has finally been identified and eliminated.
- Trees planted by Kasimir, after being cut down and the stump dug out with a shovel, no longer leave an eternally "treed" spot.
- Stacks of grass, hay, etc., hold 40 units of the resource. The same as a single bale of the resource.
- Inside new farm buildings, it no longer rains.
- Machines overturned in an unfortunate manner are easier to set upright.
- The description of a fresh egg no longer causes confusion regarding poultry breeding. All you need is a rooster and a flock of hens. Eggs do not participate in the process.
- In addition to the above, we have managed to identify and fix a huge number of bugs. Of course, all thanks to you, dear players!

[h3]Coming soon[/h3]
- Cultivator.
- Concrete, multi-stall pigsty.
- New types of roofing materials.

- Kazimierz has learned how to build two new types of garage sheds. They are perfect as a garage for a combine harvester or as a roof for distillery farms.
- Physically active stacks of items (barrels, bags, boxes, cubes, etc.) now constitute an obstacle for animal navigation.
- While plowing with horses, it's no longer necessary to manually ensure the camera is facing the right direction.
- Pop-up notifications are now more readable.
- Dead animals left on the ground decompose on their own after a few months.
- In the summer, herbivorous animals become hungry much slower, but they do not replace the mower or scythe. Grass still needs to be removed manually.
- Unwanted stacks of hay, grass, straw, etc., can be removed by burning them with the help of a kerosene lamp. The same applies to cubes and hay drying racks. The racks themselves are fire-resistant.
- Chaff cutters and threshers can be loaded by throwing the appropriate items onto them, both in cubes and in loose form using forks.
- Mowing now generates significantly less grass. This applies to both the scythe and the mower, as well as the combine harvester.
- Grass and its rotting derivatives do not turn into rotten mush after winter but simply decompose and disappear without a trace.
- It's possible to spear cubes on forks and throw them. The cubes, not the forks.
- Animals can now be cleaned by dousing them with water from a bucket.
- It's now possible to milk cows and goats without taking them out of their stalls. Remember, even locked stalls can feed... remotely. Just let them out for a walk sometimes, ok?
- Kazimierz can use fast travel even when overloaded. But travelling on foot, on bike or an animal might take more time, depending on carried weight.
- The sound range of animal footsteps is now significantly reduced.
- Two new volume sliders have appeared in the settings: for our "dialogs" (otherwise known as mumbling) and for Kazimierz's footsteps.
- The range of the mouse sensitivity slider in the settings has been significantly widened.
- The availability of scrap at Stefan's and the twins at the sawmill has increased.
- The production of vodka (based on oat mash) is now just as profitable as the production of other alcohols.
- Using the map through the inventory button no longer drops the boxes carried in hands, allowing for the use of fast travel with boxes in hands when playing with a controller.
- Picking up items from wagons or trailers will no longer cause explosions or jittering. However, a solid displacement of the vehicle can still occur, because Kazek is really a strong guy.
- Priest Mateusz has discovered a new tradition of the Kazimierz family and has an idea for a related new task.

notes.title: Farmer's Life now in Full release! 🌾🚜
notes.content:
[h2]Howdy Farmers!🌾[/h2]

We're absolutely thrilled to share some fantastic news with our amazing Farmer's Life community🥳. After months of hard work, dedication, and invaluable feedback from our incredible players, [b]Farmer's Life is officially graduating from Early Access[/b]! 🚀

All those who still haven't bought Farmer's Life, now you can get it as a full game with a [b]20% launch discount[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1137750/Farmers_Life

[h3][b]What's New?[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] We've added a new main storyline. Kazimierz receives letters from a stranger. They will help explain a mystery from the past and help you overcome the path from poverty to wealth. Completing this thread will also allow you to consider the game officially completed (but of course you can continue playing indefinitely).
[*] A new tractor as a reward at the end of the story.
[*] Development of Zalesie by investing in new farms throughout the village. Farms can set the production of goods and earn money from it.
[*] Completing the storyline unlocks a marina on the river and a boat that can be used to catch fish and drifting "treasures".
[*] You can start the game on your own rules. In this mode, you can change settings such as the speed of time, and inventory capacity or turn off the rotting of products. Players have long been asking for certain things to be regulated. However, you will not be able to earn Steam Achievements in this mode.
[*] We have added support for Czech, Hungarian, and Portuguese.
[*] You can harness another horse to the cart. The car won't go faster, but it looks nice.
[*] The inhabitants of Zalesie also accept meals prepared by Kazimierz as gifts. Everyone has their favorites.
[*] Kazimierz can build on his farm from the very beginning without having to purchase a permit from the village head.
[*] The disappearance of farm animals is now much less common.
[*] We have fixed a huge number of bugs thanks to reports from our tireless players.
[*] We have optimized many aspects of the game, which is especially noticeable on more advanced farms.
[*] We've added Steam Achievements
[/list]

[h3][b]Thank You, Farmers![/b][/h3]
We want to extend our heartfelt gratitude to each and every one of you who participated in the Early Access phase. Your passion, bug reports, and creative ideas have been invaluable in shaping Farmer's Life into the game it is today. We couldn't have done it without you!

[h3][b]What's Next?[/b][/h3]
The journey doesn't end here! We're committed to continually supporting Farmer's Life with regular updates, bug fixes, and possibly even more exciting content based on your ongoing feedback.

Thank you for joining us on this farming adventure. Whether you're a seasoned agricultural expert or a greenhorn just starting, Farmer's Life is now more captivating than ever.

Get your overalls ready, sharpen those plows, and let's embark on a bountiful journey together!

🌾Happy farming🌾
Farmer's Life Development Team👨‍🌾👨‍🌾👨‍🌾

notes.title: Farmer's Life - Cultivating Dreams
notes.content:
We are getting closer to the full release of Farmer's Life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35624648/1add52c134e2c0e1d4337d37d316b1eb3eca5726.jpg[/img]

Along our development path, we met players who, over time, formed a [u][b]great community[/b][/u] that is still active and thriving today! However, many of you probably know little about our beginnings. Here is a [b]brief history of the creation of Farmer's Life[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35624648/efafca678a28ed8f4ebccb0604937ba3e9771cdb.png[/img]


[h3][b]Entry 1: Inception of the Seed (2019)[/b][/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/BYl1sAj.gif[/img]

The journey of Farmer's Life began with a simple idea - to create a farming simulation game that would not only capture the essence of rural life but also provide players with an immersive and authentic farming experience. The team gathered around a shared passion for both gaming and agriculture, setting the foundation for what would become a labor of love.

[h3][b]Entry 2: Planting the Conceptual Seeds (start of 2020)[/b][/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fWDh8oq.gif[/img]

Initial brainstorming sessions involved sketching out the core gameplay mechanics and features. The team drew inspiration from classic farming games while also aiming to introduce innovative elements that would set Farmer's Life apart. Concepts like dynamic weather, realistic crop growth cycles, and a deep relationship system with NPCs took root during this phase.

[h3][b]Entry 3: Tilling the Technical Soil (mid 2020)[/b][/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/eS54zfg.gif[/img]

With a solid concept in place, the development team delved into the technical aspects of the game. Choosing the right engine, establishing an efficient workflow, and defining the art style were critical components. Unity was selected as the development platform, and a stylized, yet true-to-life art direction was chosen to create a visually appealing and charming world for players to explore.

[h3][b]Entry 4: Growing the Gameplay (End of 2020)[/b][/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/1tMhZru.gif[/img]

As the first playable builds emerged, the focus shifted to refining and expanding the gameplay. Crop planting, animal husbandry, and resource management systems were implemented and iterated upon. The team also experimented with different quest structures to keep the gameplay engaging and rewarding.

[h3][b]Entry 5: Weathering the Storms (start of 2021)[/b][/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bPw8Fg3.gif[/img]

Testing became crucial during this phase, with the team ironing out bugs and adjusting game balance. The introduction of dynamic weather patterns added a layer of realism, creating a more immersive environment. Player feedback played a pivotal role in fine-tuning these systems.

[h3][b]Entry 6: Nurturing Community Feedback (mid 2021)[/b][/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/s6UjGAZ.gif[/img]

The decision to involve the community early on proved invaluable. Regular updates and community engagement through social media channels helped shape the game based on player preferences. Many features were added in response to the community's desire for a more social and customizable experience.

[h3][b]Entry 7: Harvesting the Fruits of Labor (5th of August 2021)[/b][/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ycuwYek.gif[/img]

After months of dedication, Farmer's Life was ready for its initial release. The game offered players a chance to escape into a virtual countryside, where they could cultivate crops, raise animals, and build relationships with the in-game characters. The team celebrated the positive reviews and player testimonials, marking the successful harvest of their creative endeavors.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/yKul0W7.gif[/img]

After that, we did not end our cooperation with players, but expanded it! We have delivered countless updates, and expanded, and improved the game. The culmination of this work will be on tomorrow's launch. 

[h3][b]ALL ARE INVITED TO JOIN US IN THIS PRECIOUS MOMENT. THANK YOU FOR YOUR SUPPORT[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Open beta 0.9.56
notes.content:
[h3]Changes[/h3]
- The game now saves its state MUCH faster than before. Especially those with larger cultivated fields will feel this improvement.
- Kerosene lamps now burn fuel. Remember to turn them off if they're not needed. Or switch to electric lighting.
- Trailers and wagons now have more effective brakes and won't roll down an incline without reason.
- A picked up distillery now returns all the fuel and mash (if it remained untouched).
- You can no longer "produce" honey by the method: place a beehive in the summer, collect honey, destroy the beehive, place it again, and repeat.
- From now on, Kazimierz has permission to build and electrify within his farm's area right from the start.
- Bales of hay/grass/wheat/oats/straw are now more spacious.
- The motorcycle's trunk has become more spacious, and the water pots in the kitchen and distilleries are larger.
- Seeds now take up significantly less space in the inventory.
- Barrels for liquids no longer fit in Kazimierz's pocket. They must be carried by hand or transported in another way.
- Barrels with liquids and fuel barrels are now much harder to tip over.

notes.content:
[h3]🌾 Greetings, Farmers! 🌾[/h3]

In celebration of [b]World Farmer's Day👨‍🌾👩‍🌾[/b], we invite you to showcase your agricultural prowess in our 7-day contest, starting from [b]October 12th to October 19th[/b]. Let the world marvel at the fruits of your labor and the beauty of your virtual farms!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35624648/4f556be43c21c37db76c9771f700fafa2cb4a70a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.9
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Kf58qzEomMk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Changes[/h3]
- A miracle happened in Zalesie. The time flows as it used to, but the days are longer. You can sleep less and work more now!
- Trader NPCs opening hours are longer too.
- The winter is not only way more efficient, but also more easy on the eyes.
- Zalesie sounds different now. Matthew's prayers have been answered and the relentless wind is quieter now.
- Kasimir learned how to build more storage structures: a small chest, a toolshed and a big storage shed.
- You can increase capacity of the dugout by the house. Ask Anthony at the State Farm for such services.
- Kasimir has learned how to distinguish grass from hay. Hay is a well dried grass, so you can dry your grass now using new haystands.
- The hay replaced the grass in trade and some of the animals like eating it. The hay does not rot.
- Throwing grass or hay with a hayfork automatically creates interactive stacks.
- The recently lowered income from hunting activities is increased now, and Kasimir works faster in his slaughter at the barn.
- Kasimir learned how to fry poultry using his kitchen.
- Kasimir decided it would be nice to clean up barn's intertior to get more free space. 
- Kasimir decided he doesn't always need a company to improve his mood with a smoke. You can "consume" cigarettes alone and anytime you like.
- Helen always gives mash recipes for the alcohols she wants Kasimir to prepare.
- Kasimir sealed roof of contructions he built so the rain doesn't fall right trough them.
- We managed to decrease memory usage significantly. Players who were forced to play using lowest texture quality may try increasing it now.

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
- After harvesting the soil no longer claims there is still somethingh growing in it.
- Fast travelling on bike or motorcycle no longer consumes unexpected amounts of time.
- Selling animals no longer causes errors. You can sell chickens and roosters both in cages and released inside the selling pen.
- You can no longer try to steal your own animals.
- You can no longer reach stratoshpere flying on a freshly killed animal.
- Numerous bugs concerning loading savegame files were fixed.
- Trailer's sides check more precisely if they can close or not.
- Engines carried in hands can no longer propel machines remotely.
- Thadeus doesn't cheat about his wager with Kasimir.
- Talking to the mayor no longer breaks fast travelling.

notes.title: Developers' view of the latest update
notes.content:
Dear Farmer's Life fans,

First of all, we would like to apologize to unsatisfied players about the latest update. You certainly want to know why some of the changes are controversial.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35624648/8f5112105c9a15a73a1bb890399549909737f815.jpg[/img]

At the beginning of our journey, and even after the game's release in early access on Steam, we never expected that such a large number of fantastic players would take interest in our game, create a thriving community, and play, play, play, and play some more. Due to the fact that we are a small studio, on the one hand this is our first experience with such player support, on the other hand, when releasing/designing the game it was difficult to predict that a few years later there may be a situation of stability and performance problems due to, for example, too many animals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35624648/8c731e1ecbb8e33dccab8ebcbae1df92adab0925.png[/img]

Our intention has never been to make the enjoyment of the game unpleasant for players, but to provide constantly new experiences but also challenges. For the aforementioned reason, an update allowing us to continue adding content had to come. We were so anxious for you to have fun that it comes too late. We understand your bitterness, we treat everything with the utmost seriousness and promise that with this update, others with numerous and interesting mechanics, equipment and events will come soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35624648/95c3f6de8294c1d033db58f8a68187226e9a889c.png[/img]

We hope you will understand, and continue to support us, and we will continue to work hard and provide you with constantly new experiences, with the lowest possible percentage of those
negative ones.

Remember, you can always contact us on discord: [url=https://discord.gg/Ev42djcSNH]Discord[/url].

Greetings,
Farmer's Life team

notes.title: Update 0.7.06
notes.content:
[h3]Changes[/h3]
- The mayor decided to verify how the heck can Kasimir earn faster than him. He discovered many irregularities and introduced a new order.
- Animals have discovered how tasty vegetables straight from the garden are. Keep animals away from your crops!
- Kasimir learned how to plow without cutting the grass first. The work progresses slower, but if a man is persistent, he will plow even the most overgrown fields.
- The grass visibility in March was increased which makes working the fields easier after the winter.
- Kasimir learned how to fast travel while controlling a plow and under other circumstances he tought were impossible (like towing a treelog with a horse for example).
- Kasimir discovered how to disassemble the old woodshed by the house (just like any other structure he built himself).
- Kasimir learned how to setup a woodworking station in the sheds he built.
- Kasimir learned how to use a string to change stacks of hay or straw into handy cubes. Ask Johnny or Steven.
- Kasimir can now grow mushrooms in his sheds. All you need is setup a proper station and supply some manure regularly.
- You can no longer take of the meals off the stove before they are finished which led to disappearance of both ingredients and the meals.
- Tractor accidents don't always require a replacement part now, but have a wrench on you just in case.
- State Agricultural Farm found out tobacco is a worthwhile resource.
- The threshing machine became more efficient and the cutter produced more logical amounts of fodder based on the ingredients it was given.
- We managed to make our game a little slimmer. It's less of a resource hog now, loading times are noticably shorter and memory usage is lower reducing the chance of crashing to desktop.

notes.title: Update 0.5.32
notes.content:
[h3][b]Changes:[/b][/h3]
- Time flows slower in Zalesie from now on.
- Potato beetle that was destroying the savegame files was eradicated. Potatoes grow healthy and save properly.
- "Report a bug" lets you send you latest savegame file.
- Killed animals stored inside crates no longer corrupt savegame files.
- Cutting down trees and leaving them on the ground unfinished doesn't block saving the game anymore.
- The bike still likes to jump wildly from time to time, but it always gets back where Kasimir has left it.
- Kasimir no longer flies away while working the plow.
- Relations with other villagers are no longer forgotten when saving the game.
- Tractor was possessed by a demon consuming the fuel with the engine off. It was exorcised away properly (and fuel usage got lowet too).
- Tractor is not so fragile anymore. Even a nasty crash destroys less parts now.
- Tractor is not scaring villagers anymore (it was the fuel demons fault).
- Korean and Chinese fonts have been generated from scratch and no longer display "squares".
- Tiringly loud running footsteps sounds in the barn are no longer tiringly loud.
- "Take all" could generate bugs from time to time, but is much safer now.
- NPC that hates you very much will let you know about it if you try to talk to him instead being silent and uninteractive.
- Collection quests mind currently equipped items too from now on.
- Helpful villagers no longer refill tanks and crates with useful stuff for Kazimir to exploit.
- Errors appearing for no apparent reason were caused by... foggy weather. It's fixed now.
- Slaughter bench in the barn got more anti-bug safeguards.
- The bags of items you throw out during tutorial stages stay available to you, so you can recover the items.
- The lamps found in the bunkers behave like normal lamps instead acting like little magical flames.
- Coffee was nerfed.
- Many other minor tweaks and fixes.

[h3][b]Known issues:[/b][/h3]
- Disappearing interactions are still here and remain unpunished (When that happens try to sleep in a bed or save and reload the game).
- If your latest savegame turns interactions off, please, send it to us using "Report a bug" tool!

[h3][b]Workarounds:[/b][/h3]
- If your animal is stuck try to lead it and use fast travel. It will reset itself.
- If your cart is stuck try to pull it and use fast travel. It will reset itself.
- If your tractor or bike is stuck ride it and use fast travel, It will reset itself.

notes.title: Join Farmer's Life devstream!
notes.content:
Farmer’s Life is a first simulator that will show you real, sometimes dark life on the farm. You will run Kazimir’s life - a bachelor and alcoholic. Help him to become an exemplary farmer, start a family, take care of the farm or watch him going down. Besides that, don’t forget that living on the farm follows its own rules. Your rhythm of day and night and of work are determined by a lot of factors - such as weather conditions, seasons and resources, you manage.

[*] Explore the world - Outside the farm is where the danger lies, but also fun. Go ahead!
[*] Learn about the countryside - Mapping of the stereotypical countryside will impress every city guy and show how unpredictable can be living on the farm.
[/list]

notes.title: Meet Kazimir - bachelor, alcoholic and... farmer.
notes.content:
More about [b]Farmer's Life[/b]: 
Morning! Your day starts at sunrise. After all, you have a job to do… or another surprise keg party with the neighbors. 
A good farmer starts the day by dealing with the flock. The better you will manage, the better results you will achieve. Better care means a greater yield, more meat and extra eggs. Sell the fruits of your labor and you will be able to buy new barn equipment or distillation apparatus. Afterward, it’s time to work in the field. Weed, fertilize and irrigate. Rough field, freakish weather or uninvited guests can trouble you in achieving your goal. It depends on you, how you will face them. After a busy day, you deserve something special, don’t you? Neighbours will love to go for a shot. Be careful though, as they can become another trouble, you will have to manage. 
In Farmer’s Life you will have to learn how to compromise and make decisions, which will affect your fate. It’s time to start farming!
